tagline: Moved: OpenVibe.AI's public pages are OpenVibe.Exchange.
description: OpenVibe.AI is the network's AI gateway: OpenAI-compatible providers, Anthropic, local and open models behind one API, with routing for cost, speed, quality or privacy, provider fallback, versioned prompt templates, durable runs, embeddings and speech to text. Its public pages moved into OpenVibe.Exchange on 2026-11-07; this address keeps the API, a run's receipt and the operator console.
